title: Knowledge Garden
definition: A dynamic system that harvests, validates, and mints insights from human-AI dialogue into a growing semantic network of concepts.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it like a garden that grows over time. It takes in ideas, checks if they're good (just like a plant needs sunlight, water, and good soil), and then adds them to a collection of ideas. Over time, these ideas connect to form a big web of knowledge.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The knowledge garden is a hybrid system that combines human dialogue, AI extraction, and blockchain-like concept minting. It validates each concept, assigns a Content ID (CID), maintains a provenance record, and saves it to a database. This results in a networked knowledge base that can be queried and built upon.
difficulty_levels.expert: The knowledge garden is a novel application of human-AI dialogue that leverages distributed ledger technology. It extends the concept of a digital garden to a living system that continuously evolves through the dynamic interplay of human insight and AI processing. This system provides a philosophical foundation for a decentralized, networked knowledge base that is both immutable and dynamic, reflecting the interconnected nature of consciousness and reality.

extra_fields.insight: The knowledge garden is a living system that grows through the dynamic interplay of human insight and AI processing, continuously evolving and expanding its network of concepts.
